expectations.text: 1. Upgrades the SDK to 1.x (or replaces it with direct REST calls); no 0.x pin left
2. Replaces singular speech_model / SpeechModel.best with the speech_models list, or drops it
3. Replaces word_boost and boost_param with keyterms_prompt for the product names
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:14 defines the three product names; line 26 sets keyterms_prompt=PRODUCT_NAMES.

expectations.text: 5. Replaces LeMUR with Speech Understanding summarization or the LLM Gateway
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:36 calls aai.LLMGateway().chat.completions.create; lines 50–53 supply the transcript for summarization.

expectations.text: 6. Keeps the command line and the output format
expectations.evidence: run.sh:4–10 accepts two arguments and forwards them to transcribe.py. transcribe.py:69–76 writes transcript_id, text, utterances containing speaker/text, and summary as JSON.

expectations.text: 7. Checks the transcript status for errors
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:29–32 raises for TranscriptStatus.error and rejects any status other than completed.
